A [[human]] [[Gender|male]] '''Imperial officer''' served in the [[Seelos system]] during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. The [[Imperial officer|officer]] noticed a binary transmission from an old [[Clone trooper|clone]] [[Wolffe|unit]] and reported it to [[Imperial Security Bureau|ISB]] [[Agent]] [[Alexsandr Kallus|Kallus]].<ref name="Lost Commanders" />
